description: Expose SQL Server extended events from files and session targets. Can use SQL connection strings saved in SSMS registered servers files or MRU connections, or a single connection set by the CONNECTION_STRING environment variable.
name: io.github.shueybubbles/xe-mcp

connection_string.description: ADO.Net connection string to connect to the server. Defaults to localhost/Windows authentication.

ssms_connections.description: Set to true to use SSMS registered servers and MRU connections instead of the CONNECTION_STRING variable

regsrvr_file.description: Path to the SSMS registered servers file. If not set, the default path will be used. Ignored if SSMS_CONNECTIONS is not set to true.
